description: List the exact canonical car makes (brands) Clara Carros can value/find — or, given a make, that brand's models — using the exact strings the other tools expect. Call this FIRST (or whenever unsure of the spelling) and pass the returned values verbatim into estimate_resale_value / search_inventory. No make = the list of brands; with a make = that brand's models.

make.description: Brand to list models for, e.g. 'BMW'. Omit to get the list of brands.

name: list_makes_models
